event.proposal: Family: parameter tying. Current retained frontier is 1,529 parameters at 99.200000%, a +0.200000 percentage-point margin over 99%. There have been 69 prior macro-attempts in this family and 612 prior micro-trials. The most recent accepted result is attempt-0171/micro-0012 at 1,540 parameters and 99.02%; the most recent failed result is attempt-0171/micro-0013 (FF-output pair 236/180 discarded at 98.98%). This is a parameterization-preserving compression of the depth-shared feed-forward output map: union flattened coordinates 138 and 99, values -0.1309382766 and -0.1301382184 (difference 8.001e-04), using a weighted mean and integer reconstruction. Hypothesis: residual-stream reconstruction contains near-duplicate scalars distinct from FF-input redundancy, preserving qualification at 1,528 parameters. It is more informative than the next FF-output union (difference 8.186e-04) because it is the minimum-distortion isolated test of the complementary FF map. Official acceptance and rollback are unchanged.
